links.outcome: AI vs expert agreement on Weight Sensitivity Instrument item scoring
links.effect: 7 of 11 items good/very good agreement (Gwet's AC1≥0.71); three context-dependent items persistently poor (final AC1=0.42, 0.66, 0.64).
links.quote: Three other items had persistent poor agreement (final Gwet's AC1=0.42, 0.66, 0.64).

unlisted_practices: Iterative prompt engineering of AI scoring rubric guided by AI-human interrater reliability results (improved one item from Gwet's AC1=0.56 to 0.89; not effective for context-dependent items)
